summary: Carded at the user request during the MPI-467 smoke fill. A transient wrapper install 404 on a cold -cpu Pod opened the Download Failed + REPORT ON GITHUB dialog, which routes/remoteModels.js:89 explicitly says must be a toast. Hit all 12 ltx-23-balanced deps; a re-POST fixed it. User is putting a second session on it.

todo -> doing. Root cause traced end to end: wrapperFetch knows a 404/502/503/504 is transient, but remoteInstallDep throws a bare Error so the verdict dies at the throw; downloadManager then aggregates it into a model-level download:failed with no flag and the renderer defaults to the ui:error Report-on-GitHub branch. Fixing by carrying the verdict, mirroring the MPI-427 networkBlocked precedent.

Fix shipped in 20ac408b. wrapperFetch already knew the status was transient; remoteInstallDep threw a bare Error so the verdict died at the throw and the renderer defaulted to the Report-on-GitHub branch. Now stamped at the source, stashed on the dep job, carried on the model-level broadcast, toasted in the renderer - mirroring MPI-427 networkBlocked. Retry budget UNCHANGED. Acceptance 1+2 proven (new test, 5 checks; npm test 493/493). Acceptance 3 (live cold __cpu__ Pod inside its 404 window) NOT done - blocked, a sibling session held the app and the remote engine. Recipe in validation.md.

doing -> done on LOCAL evidence. Re-verified the whole chain on disk this session, not from the commit message: remoteModels.js:386+450 stamp err.transient on both throw sites via isTransientProxyStatus, downloadManager stashes it on the failed dep (2397) and carries it on the model-level broadcast (2448), and downloadService.js branches on data.transient to ui:warning in BOTH renderer arms (616 job-known, 639 job-unknown) ahead of the ui:error Report-on-GitHub fallback. tests/remote-transient-install-toast.test.cjs: 5 checks, green. Swept the rest of the renderer for the same defect class and found no second hole: _firePost's pre-flight branch cannot receive a transient (both remote pre-checks, remoteModelsCheck at downloadManager 2153 and remoteActiveInstallIds at 2180, swallow to logger.warn, so /comfy/models/download/start never returns the wrapper's status); the __universal_workflow__ arm returns early into MpiEngineInstall._setError, which is in-modal text and not the GitHub dialog; notificationService has no download:failed handler; commandExecutor's arch-weight install already ends in ui:warning. Acceptance 3 (a REAL cold __cpu__ Pod inside its 404 window) is still NOT proven and is not closable here - the user put :3000, remote connect and Pod creation out of bounds for this session (a live smoke matrix owns them) and the Pod that produced the original 404 window was deleted at the end of its install leg. Queued as item 9 on the _archived/MPI-385 Pod-verification sweep with the cheap recipe (a throwaway 10GB volume and one small dep reproduce it - it is a timing window, not a volume-size condition). routes/downloadManager.js NOT touched this session: MPI-481 holds it, so it is deliberately absent from files.json even though the shipped fix has one line there.
